annotation_policy: all visible true birds in each frame; exclude logos, reflections, prey; boxes xywh in source pixels
annotator: assistant; detector-assisted, with manual corrections on reviewed sequences

second_pass.method: rendered frame-by-frame visual review plus cross-check with independent pretrained COCO bird detector and optical-flow continuity for bird-19

quality_decisions.finding: COCO bird detector missed both visible parrots; two boxes were confirmed by direct frame inspection.
COCO produced false bird candidates on pavement; only the visible rooster was retained and boxed around the full body.
Separated peafowl and hen, and added partial visible bird in the left flock after visual review.
Removed the clear watermark and added visible partial birds at the top using independent model proposals checked against the frames.
Added seven individual bird tracks per consecutive frame with optical-flow propagation from a manually reviewed key frame; rendered sequence checked for coverage and edge clipping.

approval_scope: 84 consecutive frames across 7 sequences only; not full annotation of all source frames
